title: Vector Space Model in IR
content: The vector space model represents text documents as vectors of identifiers such as index terms. It is used in information retrieval, filtering, indexing, and relevancy rankings.

title: TF-IDF Weighting Scheme
content: Term frequency-inverse document frequency is a numerical statistic intended to reflect how important a word is to a document in a collection or corpus.

title: Cosine Similarity Search
content: Cosine similarity measures the similarity between two non-zero vectors of an inner product space. It is frequently used in text matching and information retrieval.

title: Natural Language Processing Pipeline
content: Text preprocessing involves lowercasing, tokenization, stopword removal, and lemmatization to clean raw text before building inverted indices.
